fields.label: Apply the 1st coat of PU Magnum Primer in a vertical direction and allow it to dry as per manufacturer's technical methodology
Apply the 2nd coat of primer in horizontal direction to fill remaining lumps and voids left by the 1st coat
Once the primer is completely dry, apply ready-made PU Magnum waterproofing chemical in a vertical direction
Apply 2nd coat of PU Magnum in horizontal direction after the 1st coat has dried
While the 2nd coat of PU Magnum is still wet on the 1 ft wall skirting area, sprinkle clean quartz sand to create mechanical grip for subsequent plastering
Lay down a heavy -duty cotton protective sheet over the entire chemical treated area to safeguard the membrane against punctures or wear and tear during brickbat .
Pond water for 48 hours right now to check the main membrane integrity before hiding it under the brickbat .
Establish the drainage slope from highest point down to the rainwater outlets and mark level buttons ( thiyya )
Spread bedding mortar over the area and embed broken brickbat firmly into the mortar matching the slope .
Leave the gaps between the brickbat open, do not fill them on the same day to allow the bedding mortar breathe and set .
Cure and pond water over the open brickbat layout for 3,4 days .
Pack the brickbat gaps tightly using a mortar admixed with waterproofing liquid ( dr.fixit ) .
Spread cement slurry evenly over the entire brickbat area and finish the base surface smoothly with a trowel .
Before the slurry fully harden rough the surface with wire brush to create grip for final coat .
Install the final protective layer ( chips coba) over the entire surface ,fill the all joints smoothly while strictly maintaining the predefined slope toward the drain .

Perform final test by ponding water on the finished surface for 72 hours check the underside of the slab for any leaks any where on the surface after draining                 ( perfect slope execution )
